name: Advertisement / Promotion
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-028 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Slash-boundary hold: advertisement and sales-promotion remain mandatory discriminated profiles and operational evidence may later justify separate model identities.
Relation hold: WM-MED-001 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-028 edge.
Identity hold: campaign, promotional instrument, advertisement, sales promotion, creative, claim, placement, dissemination, interaction, redemption and settlement remain distinct.
Claim hold: qualification, omission, comparative basis, evidence, test, endorsement, material connection, sponsor, payer, disclosure and challenge status remain explicit.

State hold: approval never proves legality, release never proves dissemination, impression never proves viewability or response, attribution never proves causality and redemption never proves settlement.

Targeting and privacy hold: purpose, lawful basis, consent, objection, suppression, prohibited attributes, sensitive data, minors, protected groups and vulnerability safeguards remain jurisdiction scoped.
Commercial hold: promotion benefit, offer, price, entitlement, transaction, discount allocation, clearing, payment and ledger consequences remain separate masters.
Source-access hold: two GS1 resources were verified through official indexed content while direct automated access was publisher-blocked.

Profile hold: broadcast, print, out-of-home, search, social, influencer, retail, direct, native, video, audio, political, health, finance, alcohol, gambling, children and environmental-claim uses need separate profiles.
Interoperability hold: every IAB, GS1, EU, FTC, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: legal, privacy, consumer-protection, accessibility, advertising-operations, promotion, tax, accounting and independent external review are outstanding.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
